decision_conditions: Air conditioning condenser unit cannot be introduced under a Section 73 application where it was not originally proposed, it will need to be applied for under a new planning application - reference needs to be removed from all supporting documents. Applicant to agree revised description of development
description: Variation of listed building consent PA25/1051 to allow for: Reduction in the size of the consented extension; Retention of existing rooflight; Retention of the existing external stairs at the western end of Strawberry House, with the adjacent external door replaced by a new timber door to match the existing; Alteration to the pitch of the consented extension roof, with an overall height reduction compared to the consented proposals. The roof finish is revised from fish-scale tiles to standing seam zinc. Internal works comprise: Introduction of vaulted ceiling to the studio at first floor; Revision to the second floor layout, with bathroom and study rooms swapped; Revision to the second-floor layout, with the bathroom and study rooms swapped; and Omission of the double-height library to the western end of Strawberry House.
